'''D4-N7''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. On Tatooine he worked in the [[Stillsand Waves]] area of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].
